_comment: Every entry of the Bank of England's banking known-issues log that neither rwa-filer's packaged deny list (a deny entry's known_issue) nor its publisher-issue register (publisher_log[].entry) covers, per shipped taxonomy release. Held by tests/contracts/test_known_issues_dispositions.py, which checks each kind against the newest log in docs/assets: 'amended' needs the entry's Status to say 'Amended in <version>' at or before the release; 'owed' is the only kind an open entry naming a rule the release ships can take, and needs an OWNER: P<n>.<n> token naming the plan bullet that will deny-list it or log it on a publisher issue, a bullet IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md holds open (every OWNER token here, of any kind, is held to an open bullet, as in the other parked registers); 'no_rule' is for an open entry naming no rule of the release, and 'implemented_at' names each file that acts on it. Edited by hand; a disposition for an entry something else covers is stale and fails.
